title: Checking the company's mobile phone bills against the handset list and the contracts on file
task: Checking the company's mobile phone bills against the handset list and the contracts on file
trigger: the monthly bill arrives by email at the start of the month

steps.name: open the bill and download the lines
steps.whatHappens: Open the bill and download the spreadsheet of lines.
steps.decidedHow: the bill arrives by email and I download the spreadsheet of lines

steps.name: check each line against the handset list
steps.whatHappens: Check every line on the bill against the list of handsets we have.
steps.decidedHow: the handset list is the record of what people are meant to have

steps.name: check the line against the contract
steps.whatHappens: Check the line against the contract for that handset.
steps.decidedHow: the contract says what the line is meant to cost

steps.name: note the line and mark the issue type
steps.whatHappens: Note the line and mark what kind of problem it is.
steps.decidedHow: the issue type decides whether finance or IT deals with it

steps.name: total the charges and write the summary
steps.whatHappens: Total the charges and write a summary for finance.
steps.decidedHow: finance needs one figure rather than the line detail

dependsOn: the handset list being up to date
mistakeConsequence: a wrong charge is paid for another month
frustration: the same wrong charges come back every month
